chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning's Rescue: Seven Empyrean Gods Obliterate the Broken Horn Army in Desolate Era
chapter_meta_description: Captured by a Sacred-general, Ji Ning is moments from despair as seven Empyrean Gods descend, melting armies and killing gods in a show of absolute power.
og_title: Seven Gods Descend: The Calm Before the Storm
og_description: Just when all hope is lost, seven ancient Empyrean Gods appear to lay waste to the invading army of the Broken Horn World.
twitter_title: The Cavalry Arrives as Seven Empyrean Gods Unleash Hell
twitter_description: Ji Ning is humbled by his first crushing defeat, then saved by seven ancient powers who wipe out an army in seconds.

lore_anchors.definition: In the Broken Horn World’s power hierarchy, this level is equivalent to an Empyrean God of the Three Realms. It is a tier of power far beyond the local 'Heaven-grade' or Celestial Immortal level.
A devastating divine ability unleashed by the child-like Empyrean God. It manifests as a sweeping gaze of golden light that melts any being below a certain power threshold into nothingness.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse. It is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.
The collective title for the supreme rulers of the Broken Horn World. They are terrifying entities who survived the ancient war against the forces of the Three Realms.
A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.

The supreme council governing the Broken Horn World, acting under the authority of the Mother Queens. Its members are Empyrean God-level Sacred-beings but tend to be less combat-experienced than the generals of the Frontier Army.
